meta.name: Broken but Beautiful
meta.description: Broken is Veer and Sameera's story where their hearts were left broken and damaged after they lost their love. Destiny has brought love in to their lives again, will they give it a second chance?

videos.title: Bleeding Memories of the Happily Ever After
videos.overview: For the past three years, Veer has been nursing his broken heart. He moves into a new home and meets Sameera.

videos.title: Haunting of the Heart
videos.overview: Sameera desperately waits in the pouring rain for Kartik to come and help. For the past one year, she has been waiting for a chance to speak to him.

videos.title: Broken Damaged Deranged
videos.overview: Sameera is disappointed when Kartik doesn’t come to meet her. When she visits her old apartment in search of her dog, she finds her house occupied by a stranger.

videos.title: Scared and Alone
videos.overview: Sameera and Veer meet at a bar. Her obsession with Kartik annoys Veer, who merely wants her to sign the papers.

videos.title: Found a Doppelganger Soul
videos.overview: Veer agrees to help Sameera in setting up a meeting with Kartik. But he continues to ignore her.

videos.title: To Make Me Whole
videos.overview: Sameera visits Kartik at his home. But when Ananya comes, he hides Sameera in his closet.

videos.title: To Mend My Heart
videos.overview: Veer rescues Sameera. Later, Sameera teams up with Veer to make Kartik jealous.

videos.title: And Drown the Pain
videos.overview: Veer, Sameera, and Kartik drive together to meet the family. The game of jealousy continues throughout the way.

videos.title: So I Breathe Again
videos.overview: Sameera realizes that what she had for Kartik was not love. Kartik is hurt to learn this.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Now that Kartik is desperate to talk to Sameera, she doesn’t feel like talking to anyone. Ishanvi insists Veer that he acknowledge his feelings for Sameera.

videos.title: If I Said I Love You
videos.overview: It’s time for Veer to face his fears as he helps Sameera deliver Ishanvi’s baby. Meanwhile, Kartik confesses his love for Sameera.

videos.title: I Made You Up Inside My Head
videos.overview: Sameera has moved on from her past. Or has she?

videos.title: Happily Ever After
videos.overview: Ahan proposes Sameera while Veer proposes Debbie for marriage.

videos.title: Puppy Love
videos.overview: Both Sameera and Veer feel they have changed as individuals because of their past relationships.

videos.title: The Penny Drops
videos.overview: Veer and Sameer question each other about their changed personalities.

videos.title: Little Death
videos.overview: Veer and Sameera are at crossroads in their relationships.

videos.title: Loves Me, Loves Me Not
videos.overview: Veer and Sameera must make a choice.

videos.title: Addicted to Love
videos.overview: Veer is showing withdrawal symptoms and is unable to get over Sameera.

videos.title: Walk Away
videos.overview: Sameera’s wedding brings Veer’s unresolved feelings to the surface.

videos.title: The Perfect Mistake
videos.overview: Veer is trying hard to come to terms with Sameera’s decision to marry.

videos.title: Broken But Beautiful
videos.overview: Ahan releases Sameera from their marriage on realizing that it was Veer after all.

videos.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Helpless Mind
